culture: Saint Petersburg blends waterfront living with an arts-forward community, giving expecting families access to a relaxed, supportive coastal culture alongside progressive wellness and maternal-care resources.
heroLocalDetail: Known as the Sunshine City, Saint Petersburg offers over 350 days of sunshine, a walkable waterfront with stunning sunsets, and a growing wellness scene that supports mindful pregnancy and birth.
medicaidNote: Florida Medicaid covers maternity care through Managed Medical Assistance (MMA) plans, including labor, delivery, and postpartum services. Contact your local Medicaid office or apply through Access Florida.
insuranceNote: Many Florida doulas work out-of-network and provide superbills for HSA/FSA reimbursement. Check if your plan offers out-of-network maternity or wellness benefits.
